1.
The written instructions supplied by learned State Counsel is taken on record.

2. The instant petition has been filed praying for quashing of order dated 11.03.2024 passed by District Magistrate, Bareilly and for a direction to the respondents to pay compensation to the petitioner alongwith admissible statutory benefits, as per the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text:
On 08.07.2024, the following order was passed:
"1. Admittedly, the subject land in dispute was taken over by the respondents long time back without any formal acquisition and payment of compensation.
The petitioner has been running after the respondents for payment of compensation but on one technical plea or the other, the respondents have not paid compensation so far to the petitioner.
Now, respondent no. 3 has passed an order to the effect that the respondents are ready to pay the amount which the petitioner paid at the time of its purchase in the year 2017 plus interest.

2. We require the Vice-Chairman, Bareilly Development Authority, Bareilly and District Magistrate, Bareilly to file their personal affidavits apprising the Court of the provisions under which possession of the land in question was taken over without any formal acquisition.

entities.text: Bareilly Development Authority, Bareilly and District Magistrate, Bareilly
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In case, proper explanation along with provision of law under which such possession was taken is not disclosed in the affidavit, we shall be compelled to direct for necessary action being taken against the officials found to be guilty of taking possession without following the rule of law.
The District Magistrate will also explain why he has not determined compensation as per the prevalent law.

3. Put up this case as fresh on 15th July, 2024.
4.

Sri D.S. Chauhan, counsel appearing for the Development Authority and Sri Rajeev Gupta, counsel appearing for the District Magistrate, shall communicate the instant order to the concerned respondents for due compliance."
4.

The Vice-Chairman, Bareilly Development Authority, Bareilly has filed his affidavit and therein the stand taken is that after the order of this Court, the Bareilly Development Authority, Bareilly resolved to pay compensation to the petitioner at the present circle rate, as provided under the Government Order dated 21.03.2016.
The petitioner agreed to the same and had executed a sale deed on 13.07.2024 in favour of Bareilly Development Authority, Bareilly and, thus, the dispute stands resolved.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner admits the aforesaid facts.
6. Therefore, the cause of action does not survive.
7. The petition is consigned.

(Manish Kumar Nigam, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 15.7.2024 Ankit.
